items.title: Tata Steel Q2 Results: Profit rises 16% YoY to Rs 3,700 crore, revenue up 11%; Noel Tata to retire as director
items.description: Tata Group's Tata Steel has reported a 16.2% year-on-year increase in profit after tax for Q2FY27. Consolidated revenue from operations grew by 11.5% year-on-year, reaching over Rs 65,436 crore. The profit after tax for the quarter was around Rs 3,700 crore, compared to the previous year's amount. Additionally, Noel Naval Tata will retire from his position effective November 11, 2026.
